canonical_events.law: YOU events join the EXISTING canonical model in the hawking-events crate. They are not a second bus. HIDE Chat, IDE, terminal, Bridge, MCP and the SDKs consume the same stream, which is what makes the three surfaces one system rather than three apps.

added.carries: content hash, kind, size, source, scope
added.note: the hash is the identity; the same bytes twice is one object with two references

added.carries: object hash, stage, derived representations produced, what remains

added.note: proposed is not committed; this is what makes memory inspectable BEFORE it lands
correction is supersession; both remain until forgotten

added.carries: connector id, account handle, scope read, object count
connector id, intended effect, permission required
added.note: proposed, never executed by the event

added.carries: url or fixture id, captured_at, quality grade, content hash
claim id, category, evidence ids, verifier
trigger, goal, permission set, budget, stop condition
automation id, outcome, resources consumed, next run
agent id, role, context capsule hash, permissions, deadline
agent id, output schema conformance, verification state
project id, state transition, what changed
from surface, to surface, capsule hash, what it excludes

every_event_carries: whether its content is target-verified or provisional
canonical_events.provisional_flag_matters_because: speculation is default-off but the Draft/Verified type wall already exists in hawking-speculate. An event carrying provisional content must be visibly provisional, or a draft token reaches a UI as though it were final.

frontend_state_contracts.law: Backend first. These are FIXTURE-DRIVEN state contracts, not designs. Vision MCP inspects and iterates the visuals later; what is frozen here is the STATE a view must render, so the redesign does not become a backend redesign.

surfaces.note: the compact label is YOU, not Personal, unless usability testing proves otherwise

surfaces.must_show: processing stage per object, because incremental processing means an object can be present and not yet usable
the four categories distinguishably. A UI that renders an inference identically to a sourced fact defeats the type separation underneath it.
that forget is real deletion, not a hidden tombstone
granted scopes explicitly; a connector whose scopes are invisible is an ambient credential with a UI
the permission set, because an automation IS a standing grant
the exclusions. A handoff that shows only what it carries hides the judgement that made it useful.

frontend_state_contracts.context_os_disclosure_requirement: the UI must be able to show what is active, what was retrieved, what was remembered, which connectors were used, what was excluded, and why. Every one of those is already a field above; none may be dropped as 'too detailed' during visual design.

grade.why: these are contracts over fixtures. Nothing here has served a real user, no connector holds a real credential, and the model that would drive YOU does not currently generate coherent text.
